expressions.name: Test Sequencer
expressions.expression:
// Test Sequencer
// Uses a state machine to step through 
// shut off mixing, purge, mix on, pause, ignite
// run a set time, mix off, purge - done

static.testState       //idle

static.timeIncPerLoop  = 7.215  //Valid for 160Hz update rate
static.deltaTime     
static.preStartTime    = 500
static.dilutionTimeOut = 15000
static.ignitionTime    = 600
static.postVentTime    = 2000
static.postPurgeTime   = 4000
static.abort1PurgeTime = 1000
static.abort2PurgeTime = 4000
static.pressTimeOut    = 2000
static.runTime         = 3000
static.runTestError

mixRemaining = static.mixRemaining
static.DilutionFactor  = 2   // dilution with LN2 to safe before run


static.ignition      // these output to control expressions that take in buttons or sequence output
static.LOXVent  
static.FuelVent 
static.Purge    
static.LOXOut   
static.FuelOut  

startTest = buttonVars.runTest
abort     = buttonVars.abort or buttonVars.purge
purgeIn   = buttonVars.purge

weight    = "Scale:Scale0"
TankPress = "AI:Ch P"
setP      = static.runTankSetPoint

IDLE           = 0
PRESTART       = 1  // condition on, press off
DILUTION       = 2  // purge on, wait timed amount
STARTPRESS     = 3  // purge off, press on wait for press >= set point
IGNITION       = 4  // fire 
RUN            = 5  // wait run time, goes to POSTPURGE
POSTPURGE      = 6  // purge, goes through engine
ABORTPOSTVENT  = 7  // vent only, depress tank
ABORTPOSTPURGE = 8  // purge, goes through engine
ABORT          = 9  // go through the abort post events

state     = static.testState
deltaT    = static.deltaTime

purge   = 0
vent    = 0
dilute  = 0
igniton = 0

if ( (abort or buttonVars.purge) and (state) and (state < ABORT) ) then
    static.deltaTime = 0
    state = ABORT
endif


if ( state == IDLE ) then    // IDLE
    if ( startTest > 0 ) then
        if ( weight > 100 or buttonVars.doFakeFuel ) then
            static.deltaTime = 0
            state=PRESTART
            print("Starting TEST")
            print("Diluting remaining mix")
        else if ( static.runTestError == 0 ) then
            static.runTestError = 1
            print("ERROR, cannot proceed with test, insufficient mix")
        endif
    else
        static.runTestError = 0
    endif
else if ( state == PRESTART ) then
    static.deltaTime = 0
    mixRemaining = weight
    print("PRESTART -> DILUTION")
    state = DILUTION
else if ( state == DILUTION ) then
    dilute = 1
    if (deltaT > static.dilutionTimeOut) then
        state = ABORT
        static.deltaTime = 0
        print("Dilution timeout -> ABORT")
    endif
    if ( (weight > (mixRemaining * static.DilutionFactor)) ) then
        state = STARTPRESS
        static.deltaTime = 0
        print("MIX Diluted in can, proceeding to press")
    endif
else if ( state == STARTPRESS) then
    if ( TankPress >= setP ) then
        print("Pressurized, igniting ->")
        state = IGNITION
        static.deltaTime = 0
    endif
    if ( deltaT > static.pressTimeOut ) then
        state = ABORT
        static.deltaTime = 0
        print("Press timeout, didn't reach pressure in time.  Going to ABORT")
    endif
else if ( state == IGNITION ) then
    ignition = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.ignitionTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        printf("Ignition should have occurred, going to RUN a bit")
        state = RUN
    endif
else if ( state == RUN ) then
    if ( deltaT > static.runTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = POSTPURGE
        print("Run complete, going to POST PURGE")
    endif
else if ( state == POSTPURGE ) then
    vent   = 1
    purge  = 1
    dilute = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.postPurgeTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = IDLE
        print("Post Purge complete -> IDLE")
    endif
else if ( state == ABORTPOSTVENT ) then
    vent   = 1
    dilute = 1
    purge  = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.postVentTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = IDLE
        print("ABORTPOSTVENT done -> IDLE")
    endif
else if ( state == ABORTPOSTPURGE ) then
    vent   = 1
    purge  = 1
    dilute = 1
    if ( deltaT > static.postPurgeTime ) then
        static.deltaTime = 0
        state = IDLE
        print("ABORTPOSTPURGE done -> IDLE")
    endif
else if ( state == ABORT ) then
    static.deltaTime = 0
    state = ABORTPOSTVENT
    print("ABORT ABORT ABORT")
endif

if ( state > 0 ) then
    static.deltaTime = static.deltaTime + static.timeIncPerLoop  //Valid for 160Hz update rate
endif

static.mixRemaining = mixRemaining
static.dilution     = dilute
static.ignition     = ignition
static.Purge        = purge
static.RunTankVent  = vent

static.testState = state

expressions.name: Line Condition LOX
expressions.expression:
// Line Conditioning for LOX
// Conditioning valve on

static.LOXmaintainDuty   = 0.33
static.LOXmaintainPeriod = 3000
static.LOXprevMaintButton


LOXBdoBleed = 0
button   = buttonVars.LOXBleedEn
maintain = buttonVars.LOXMaintain
ChillS7  = buttonVars.ChillS7

state    = static.LOXConditionState
testing  = static.testState
loading  = static.loadProp
timer    = static.LOXmaintainTimer
duty     = static.LOXmaintainDuty
period   = static.LOXmaintainPeriod
lockOut  = static.LOXmaintainLockOut

IDLE          = 0
FULLCONDITION = 1
MAINTAIN      = 2
WAITFORMAINT  = 3

LOXdoBleed = 0

if ( button == 0 ) then
    state   = IDLE
    lockOut = 0
endif

if ( loading ) then
    lockOut = 1
    button = 0
    state = IDLE
endif

if ( state == IDLE ) then
    timer = 0
    if ( button ) then
        state = FULLCONDITION
    endif
else if ( state == FULLCONDITION ) then
    LOXdoBleed = 1
    timer = 0
    if ( maintain ) then
        state = MAINTAIN
    endif
else if ( state == MAINTAIN ) then
    if ( maintain == 1 and static.LOXprevMaintButton == 0 ) then
        state = WAITFORMAINT
    endif
    if ( timer < period * duty ) then
        LOXdoBleed = 1
    else if ( timer > period ) then
        timer = 0
    endif
else if ( state == WAITFORMAINT ) then
    if ( maintain == 0 and static.LOXprevMaintButton == 1 ) then
        state = FULLCONDITION
    endif
else
    state = IDLE
endif

if ( testing == 0 and lockOut == 0 and ChillS7 == 0) then
    static.LineConditionLOX = LOXdoBleed   // This signals S4_vent too.
else
    lockOut = 1
    static.LineConditionLOX = 0            // Stop conditioning when testing
    state = IDLE
endif

static.LOXmaintainTimer = timer
if ( state == MAINTAIN ) then 
    static.LOXmaintainTimer = static.LOXmaintainTimer + static.timeIncPerLoop
endif

static.LOXprevMaintButton = maintain
static.LOXConditionState  = state
static.LOXmaintainLockOut = lockOut

expressions.name: Fuel-Fill_By_Weight
expressions.expression:
// Fill Fuel by weight.
// Read _weight continuously at first, when _weight rises by nn grams assume fuel is now going in.
// Save the _weight at this point as _static.LOXWeight, calculate needed fuel _weight to reach _static.massRatio.
// Continue to fill until total _weight equals target = LOXWeight * (1+MR)
// Minimum LOX to start is 100g

static.massRatio
static.fuelFillState
static.fuelWeight
static.prevFuelWeight
static.prevLOXWeight

static.LOXLossToLNGinput = 0.6  // grams/gram LOX boiled off for each gram of LNG added ~0.5 to 0.7 g/g

weight = "Scale:Scale0"
button = buttonVars.FillFuelByWeight
reset  = buttonVars.resetFuelFill
static.prevFuelByWeightButton

targetWeight = static.targetWeight
targetFuel   = static.targetFuel
LOXWeight    = static.LOXWeight
CorrectedLOX = static.CorrectedLOX
fuelWeight   = static.fuelWeight
fullWeight   = static.fullWeight
fuelOut      = static.FuelOutValve
minWeight    = static.minWeight
state        = static.fuelFillState
massRatio    = static.massRatio

L0 = static.L0   // initial LOX
Lf = static.Lf   // calculated final LOX
R  = static.R    // desired fuel to LOX MR
F  = static.F    // LNG mass to add

IDLE             = 0
START            = 1
WAITFORMASSUP    = 2
CALCNEEDEDMASS   = 3
WAITFORFINALMASS = 4
COMPLETE         = 5

if ( reset ) then
    state = IDLE
endif

if ( state == IDLE ) then
    if ( button and (static.prevFuelByWeightButton == 0) ) then
        if ( L0 < 100 ) then
            print("Min LOX not reached: %f", L0)
        else
            state = START
        endif
    endif
    fuelOut = 0
else if ( state == START ) then
    minWeight = weight
    state = WAITFORMASSUP
else if ( state == WAITFORMASSUP ) then
    fuelOut = 1
    if ( weight <= minWeight) then
        minWeight = weight
    else if ( weight > minWeight + 1 ) then
        LOXWeight = weight
        state = CALCNEEDEDMASS
    endif
else if ( state == CALCNEEDEDMASS ) then
    L0 = weight                    // initial LOX weight from current scale weight
    R  = massRatio                 // desired Fuel / LOX
    b  = static.LOXLossToLNGinput  // LOX boil off to LNG added g/g
    F  = (R*L0) / (1 + (R*b))      // target LNG load
    Lf = L0 / (1 + (R*b))          // LOX expected final weight
    targetFuel   = F
    targetWeight = Lf + F
    static.L0 = L0
    static.Lf = Lf
    static.F  = F
    static.R  = R
    LOXWeight = L0
    fuelOut   = 0
    state = WAITFORFINALMASS
else if ( state == WAITFORFINALMASS ) then
    fuelWeight = weight - L0
    if ( fuelWeight >= targetFuel ) then
        fuelOut = 0
        state = COMPLETE
    else
        fuelOut = 1
    endif
    static.movingLOXTarget = targetWeight - targetFuel
else if ( state == COMPLETE ) then
    state = IDLE
endif

static.prevFuelByWeightButton = button

static.fuelFillState = state
static.FuelOutValve  = fuelOut

fullWeight           = weight
static.minWeight     = minWeight
static.targetFuel    = targetFuel
static.targetWeight  = targetWeight
static.fuelWeight    = fuelWeight
static.LOXWeight     = L0 - (fuelWeight * static.LOXLossToLNGinput)
static.fullWeight    = fullWeight

expressions.expression:
// Back Flush Sequencer

static.backFlushDuration = 2000
state    = static.backFlushState
timer    = static.backFlushLoopTimer
button   = buttonVars.BackFlush
loadProp = static.loadProp

IDLE        = 0
OPENVALVES  = 1
FLUSHING    = 2
CLOSEVALVES = 3

backFlush = 0

if (loadProp == 0) then
  if ( state == IDLE ) then
    static.backFlushLoopTimer = 0
    if ( button ) then
        state = OPENVALVES
    endif
  else if ( state == OPENVALVES ) then
    backFlush = 1
    state = FLUSHING
  else if ( state == FLUSHING ) then
    backFlush = 1
    if ( timer > static.backFlushDuration ) then
        state = CLOSEVALVES
    endif
  else if ( state == CLOSEVALVES ) then
    backFlush = 0
    state = IDLE
  endif
endif

static.backFlush = backFlush
static.backFlushState = state

if ( state ) then
    static.backFlushLoopTimer = static.backFlushLoopTimer + static.timeIncPerLoop
endif

expressions.name: LN2 Conditioning
expressions.expression:
// Line & Valve conditioning for LN2

static.LN2maintainDuty   = 0.33
static.LN2maintainPeriod = 3000
static.prevMaintButton

LN2doBleed = 0
button   = buttonVars.LN2Condition
maintain = buttonVars.LN2Maintain
dilute   = buttonVars.LN2dilute

state    = static.LN2ConditionState
testing  = static.testState
timer    = static.LN2maintainTimer
duty     = static.LN2maintainDuty
period   = static.LN2maintainPeriod
lockOut  = static.LN2maintainLockOut
testLockOut = static.LN2ConditionLockOut

if ( testing ) then
    testLockOut = 1
else if ( buttonVars.LN2Condition == 0 ) then
    testLockOut = 0
endif


IDLE          = 0
FULLCONDITION = 1
MAINTAIN      = 2
WAITFORMAINT  = 3


LN2doBleed = 0

if ( button == 0 ) then
    state   = IDLE
    lockOut = 0
endif

if ( state == IDLE ) then
    timer = 0
    if ( button ) then
        state = FULLCONDITION
    endif
else if ( state == FULLCONDITION ) then
    LN2doBleed = 1
    timer = 0
    if ( maintain ) then
        state = MAINTAIN
    endif
else if ( state == MAINTAIN ) then
    if ( maintain==1 and static.prevMaintButton==0 ) then
        state = WAITFORMAINT 
    endif
    if ( timer < period * duty ) then
        LN2doBleed = 1
    else if ( timer > period ) then
        timer = 0
    endif
else if ( state == WAITFORMAINT ) then
    if ( maintain==0 and static.prevMaintButton==1 ) then // wait for release
        state = FULLCONDITION
    endif
else 
    state = IDLE
endif

static.LN2maintainTimer = timer
if ( state == MAINTAIN ) then 
    static.LN2maintainTimer = static.LN2maintainTimer + static.timeIncPerLoop
endif

static.LN2ConditionState   = state
static.LN2maintainLockOut  = lockOut
static.prevMaintButton     = maintain
static.LN2ConditionLockOut = testLockOut


if ( testing == 0 and lockOut == 0 and dilute == 0 and testLockOut == 0 ) then
    static.LineConditionLN2 = LN2doBleed   // This signals S4_vent too.
else
    lockOut = 1
    static.LineConditionLN2 = 0            // Stop conditioning when testing
    state = IDLE
endif
